title: At least 30 killed in highway fire in Cairo district
summary: A truck carrying fuel reportedly overturned on a busy highway, setting vehicles ablaze and prompting a major emergency response. Authorities warned that the death toll could rise.

title: Europe Tonight: Russia reportedly prepares nuclear satellite launch
summary: Jamie Shea, former NATO spokesperson joined Euronews' new evening show Europe Tonight to discuss how Satellite systems could be affected and what would it mean for the world.

title: Haftar visits Ankara as Erdoğan prepares first Libya trip in 15 years
summary: Eastern Libya's commander, accompanied by his son Saddam, met Turkey's defence and foreign ministers and its intelligence chief, days after Ukrainian naval drones sank the Russian warship Merkury at Benghazi's naval base.

title: Russian strikes kill seven in Ukraine as Kyiv hits three refineries
summary: Russia's drone attack killed people in six Ukrainian regions and hit a Naftogaz gas production facility, a DTEK thermal power plant and power networks in several parts of the country. Ukrainian drones struck Russian refineries in Samara and Rostov regions and an airbase in Nizhny Novgorod region.

title: Video shows massive explosion as US Army destroys entire stockpile of lead azide
summary: The US Army detonates around five tonnes of degraded lead azide at an ammunition plant in Iowa, destroying the country's entire stockpile of the explosive.

title: Wrongly deported Salvadoran arrives in Spain after US legal battle
summary: The Salvadoran, deported "by mistake" to a prison in El Salvador in 2025, has brought an end to 20 months of litigation in the United States, with Madrid as the first stop in what his lawyers describe as a temporary stay abroad.

title: Greece: 14,000 march in Athens against rising living costs
summary: Thousands demonstrated across Greece on Wednesday 25 November 2026 during a 24-hour strike against rising living costs and stagnant wages. The industrial action disrupted metro services, grounded flights and kept ferries in port.

title: Pakistan: Emergency teams search for survivors beneath collapsed building
summary: At least one person was killed and 10 others injured when a multi-storey building under construction collapsed in Karachi, on Wednesday 25 November 2026. Emergency teams are searching the rubble for people feared missing.
